title: Adhkar group file
description: One hand-authored file per group of adhkar, e.g. morning.json. Every dhikr id is author-assigned and must be globally unique across all adhkar files; ids are never generated, because user collections in the app point at them.

group.description: Free-form label for this file, e.g. 'morning'. Organisational only - it is not written to the database.

description.description: Optional note to yourself about what belongs in this file. Not written to the database.

adhkar.description: The adhkar in this group. Order here does not matter; collections decide order.

id.description: Author-assigned, globally unique, permanent. Changing it silently repoints user collections at different content.

text_arabic.description: The Arabic text of the dhikr.

transliteration.description: Optional Latin-script transliteration. Omit the key entirely when unused.

default_count.description: How many times this dhikr is said by default. A collection may override it per item with "count".

source_id.description: Optional reference into content/sources/sources.json. Must resolve at build time.

benefits.description: Optional narrated benefit or virtue. Omit when unused.

notes.description: Optional editorial note shown to the user. Omit when unused.
